detailed_analysis.safe_t_assessment: CRITICAL FAILURE - SAFE-T framework absent from suicide-related MCQs. SAD PERSONS scale used instead (outdated). No documentation of: Specific plan details, Access to lethal means, Feelings of hopelessness/burden, Earlier attempts with timeline, Threat level categorization. Only generic 'suicidal ideation' mentioned without structured assessment.
detailed_analysis.mental_health_act_compliance: PARTIAL - Involuntary admission criteria mentioned but incomplete. Missing systematic documentation of: (1) Mental illness severity, (2) Risk quantification, (3) Treatment refusal documentation, (4) Less restrictive alternatives considered and rejected. No state-specific variations (NSW/VIC/QLD) acknowledged.
detailed_analysis.medication_safety: ADEQUATE - Australian medication names used consistently. Metabolic monitoring mentioned for antipsychotics. Lithium monitoring schedule correct. However, missing QTc prolongation warnings for droperidol/ziprasidone. Clozapine agranulocytosis risk documented but myocarditis risk underemphasized.
detailed_analysis.cultural_safety: CRITICAL FAILURE - Zero Aboriginal/TSI content across 100 MCQs. No SEWB framework. No historical trauma considerations. No Aboriginal liaison offers. No interpreter services mentioned. Represents 0% of content despite Aboriginal people being overrepresented in involuntary admissions (2.5x general population).
detailed_analysis.rag_citation_quality: UNACCEPTABLE - All references show 'Unknown' titles. RAG confidence scores 0.0 for duplicate MCQs (2000-2064). Violates project constraint: 'All facts MUST have qdrant_point_id'. Zero traceable citations to Australian sources (eTG, RANZCP guidelines).
detailed_analysis.content_duplication: SEVERE - MCQs 2000-2064 (64 items) are exact duplicates of earlier MCQs. Metadata shows same 'ComprehensiveMCQGenerator-v1' timestamp. Indicates generation error. Reduces unique content from 100 to 36 MCQs.
detailed_analysis.australian_context: PARTIAL - Medication names Australian. Mental Health Act mentioned (NSW/VIC/QLD). However: No PBS restrictions, no MBS item numbers, no Australian Medicines Handbook references, no RANZCP clinical practice guidelines cited, no Australian crisis services (Lifeline/Beyond Blue) in suicide MCQs.
